show.description: Raised by Three Dads tells the heartwarming and funny story of little Meera, a girl growing up under the care of more than one father. Her strict biological father, her goofy stepdad, and her protective grandfather. As chaos, love, and life lessons unfold, must learn that raising a child isn't about perfection. It's about heart.
